entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Ooh, you brought a ton back.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya think about comin' up against[n]such ritzy food?
I'm so happy.
I just want to eat.
I'm not hungry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's cute hearin' that from someone like[n]you. Just don't get too excited, got it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're the last person I want giving advice[n]about that, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was thinkin' that too, but take a bite.[n]Usin' better ingredients makes stuff taste[n]way different!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look at you, acting like you have a refined[n]palate all of a sudden.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You say that, but you brought tons of[n]food back...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess if you don't want it, I'll just...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hands off! I'll eat it all later!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't you think you're eatin' too much,[n]Mona?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no... knowing when we'll get to[n]come here again.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sure, but you guys brought back loads[n]of food... It'd be a shame to let it all go[n]to waste.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why don't you help them out, Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We should both help.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, me? I'm wayyy too stuffed! I couldn't[n]possibly help!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah... stuffin' your face with cake...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whatever. Let's deal with this[n]ourselves!
It feels like no matter how much we eat,[n]the amount of food we have stays the[n]same...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's still more?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't give up! Let's keep at it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: W-We did it...
My belt feels multiple sizes too small...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ye— Oh yeah...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is a victory... for all of us...
That was a breeze.
That was tough.
Is this a game to you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is your stomach... the size of a freakin'[n]Palace?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We won... because we did it together...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not exactly...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Good job, you guys. How about one last[n]dish to cleanse your palates?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I recommend the seasonal tart! The[n]grapefruit has both alluring sweetness[n]and a tangy sourness!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Stop... I don't wanna hear about[n]sour stuff...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *burp* This isn't good. I gotta go to[n]the bathroom...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: M-Me too... Please... carry me gently...

entries.speaker: Elegant Woman
entries.en: My, look at that table...

entries.speaker: Wealthy Man
entries.en: Come now, pay them no attention.[n]I'm sure they must not normally have[n]the chance to eat such exquisite food.

entries.speaker: Elegant Woman
entries.en: I can only imagine what their parents[n]must be like.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What was that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Urp!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't got time for that.[n]C'mon, let's go...
